title: Diagnose SOL no-fill after expected post_only=false close
commands_run: read-only SQLite query against data/mexc.sqlite action_queue/actions_ledger
read-only MEXC lookup via list_open_orders_raw/list_history_orders_raw/list_deals_raw for SOL order 804558821271170048

preflight_intended.note: Pre-submit preview intended taker-allowed reduce-only LIMIT close, but these fields are not persisted in action_queue.

exchange_order.raw_status_summary: history order state=4 canceled, orderType=2 Post Only Maker, dealVol=0

cause.explanation: core/mexc_direct.py create_limit_order_raw uses open_type=2 for both payload type and openType. In MEXC contract API, type=1 is normal price-limited order and type=2 is Post Only Maker. Therefore every direct LIMIT submit is sent as orderType=2/post-only, regardless of runner preview post_only=false.
cause.minimal_fix_proposal: Split order_type from open_type in mexc_direct.create_limit_order_raw/create_limit_order_and_get_id. Default order_type should be 1 for taker-allowed LIMIT; OPEN post-only behavior should explicitly pass order_type=2 or order_kind=POST_ONLY through api_executor. Preserve MARKET forbidden, qty cap, and no cancel/replace/chase.
files_likely_needed: core/test_mexc_direct_signing.py or new mexc_direct payload tests

summary: SOL action 12 was locally LIMIT/reduce_only close, but the direct MEXC submit payload path still produced type=2/openType=2. Exchange history confirms orderType=2, state=4, errorCode=20, dealVol=0. The no-fill is not a misleading exchange reason; the submitted order was effectively Post Only Maker because mexc_direct maps LIMIT payload type incorrectly.
